items.headline: Telegram Rolls Out Money Wallet for $GRAM Transfers
items.summary: Telegram's new Money wallet section enables $GRAM transfers and collectibles, appearing after incoming transfers via the Walt service. A big distribution push for the TON-ecosystem token.

items.headline: $DOT DeFi Push: Polkadot Launches dotUSD Stablecoin
items.summary: Polkadot launched USDT-backed dotUSD under OpenGov with ~2.77M tokens in supply, and $DOT-backed borrowing is planned for a later phase. A fresh DeFi use case for the ecosystem.

items.headline: $STRK Eyes Own L1 for Quantum Security by 2027
items.summary: Starknet is weighing a shift to its own Layer 1 to pursue quantum security by 2027, per StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson. An independent chain would let $STRK control security upgrades without waiting on Ethereum.

items.headline: Aave Lists $MONAD AUSD PT With 93% Borrow Limit
items.summary: Aave listed December AUSD PT on Monad with a 93% borrowing limit, and the 30M-token supply cap filled fast with ~$29.67M supplied. Early sign of DeFi demand on the new $MONAD chain.

items.headline: $USDKG Winds Down After UK Sanctions Hit
items.summary: Kyrgyzstan is retiring its gold-backed $USDKG token after UK sanctions, letting holders redeem fiat or USDT. The fate of the gold reserves remains unspecified.
